title: goShare - Share your memories on blockchain
tagline: Store your memories forever and share them with world to earn, share beautiful photos which people can like and give a tip.
description:
Photos shared on web2 are not secured and there is no censorship, we wanted to create a platform where people can share there photo. In this project we propose a blockchain-based platform for user
modelling that allows users to contribute data without losing
control or ownership. This platform addresses three major
issues: maintaining privacy and user control, as well as
providing sharing incentives. A peer to peer photo sharing platform which allows users to
upload their clicked photos on blockchain and earn incentives if
other people on network likes their photo and donate them in
form of cryptocurrencies such as Sharadeum, eth etc. This platform will be censorship
resistant, nobody could remove the data when uploaded.
how_its_made: Being a beginner at blockchain event, it was overwhelming to see so many tech stacks to use. We tried to implement 4-5 tech stacks and got success in 2-3 of them and got to learn.
